question: Should this issue remain the canonical Linux/Windows companion parity roadmap, or should the remaining Linux remote-mode and parity work move to narrower trackers before this umbrella closes?
rationale: The core platform apps now exist, but source and discussion cannot determine whether remaining parity and security milestones should stay under this broad issue or be split into owner-scoped work.

options.title: Keep as parity roadmap
options.body: Retitle the issue, check off delivered Windows and Linux-local milestones, and track only approved remaining parity and security work here.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Create or identify narrow Linux remote-mode, auth-contract, operator/node, and parity trackers, then close this umbrella as implemented or superseded.

recommendation.title: Keep as parity roadmap
recommendation.body: Retitle the issue, check off delivered Windows and Linux-local milestones, and track only approved remaining parity and security work here.

likelyOwner.reason: He initiated the issue and has consistently provided the clearest product-priority guidance for companion apps.
